rationale.grounding: Field-local source IDs and exact excerpts are now valid, and chat findings correctly attribute m1/m2 to 陈夏 without borrowing m3. However, the cited 2022 interview only says 谈到设计系统实践, while the saved professional_background and summary say 参与设计系统实践. Discussing a practice is not evidence of having performed it. 转任 also suggests a transition not described by either source; the two snapshots establish separate dated positions, not the intervening career path. The inference label preserves uncertainty but does not supply evidence for the added work claim. Correcting this substantive career attribution is required, so grounding remains below 3.

rationale.recovery: Tool 3 duplicate filing was denied. Tool 4 query lost the literal @ prefix and was denied before any research request; tool 5 used the exact allowed tokens. Tool 6 premature update was denied. Official fetch tool 7 failed CONTROLLED_FETCH_TIMEOUT; historical fetch 8 succeeded, and the same official source succeeded on retry 9. Tool 11 concatenated separate chat excerpts and was denied; tool 12 split them into two exact singly cited findings and completed. One SDK api_retry event also preceded successful execution; its HTTP status/cause are unknown. The remaining semantic career claim is a grounding defect, not evidence that these tool recoveries failed.
